verdict.rationale: Floot supports iterative chat-based editing with a checkpoint/revert system (create_checkpoint, restore checkpoint) and get_logs for diagnosing regressions, directly addressing the 'don't break what works' concern via rollback rather than guaranteed non-breaking edits. Missing for 10: any independent or hands-on evidence that follow-up prompts actually preserve existing functionality, and no described mechanism (e.g., tests, diffing) beyond manual checkpoint restore to prevent regressions.
